popup.environmentLayer.gradeRuleText: RPI ≤2 unpolluted or slightly polluted; ≤3 light; ≤6 moderate; >6 severe (Ministry of Environment grading)
popup.environmentLayer.censoredText: Below the detection limit; the value shown is the limit, not a measurement
popup.environmentLayer.riverStationUpdat: Updated monthly with a lag of about 2 months; readings and RPI come from the same sampling
popup.environmentLayer.srcRiverStations: Ministry of Environment river water quality monitoring (WQX_P_01)
popup.environmentLayer.agencyDefault: Ministry of Environment, Water Resources Agency
popup.environmentLayer.sewageUncertain: Location uncertain: the address was only geocoded to an area centre or approximate position
popup.environmentLayer.srcSewage: Ministry of the Interior public sewage treatment plants (addresses geocoded with Google)
popup.environmentLayer.drinkingDefault: Drinking water source quality protection zone
popup.environmentLayer.drinkingNote: Announced by the Ministry of Environment under the Drinking Water Management Act; different from the tap water quality and quantity protection zones designated by the Water Resources Agency under the Water Supply Act.
popup.environmentLayer.srcDrinking: Ministry of Environment national drinking water source quality protection zone map (GISEPA_P_13, version of 2026-07-20)
popup.environmentLayer.seaStale: The latest sample is out of date or missing; the colour does not reflect current conditions
popup.environmentLayer.doElectrodeNote: Electrode method; titration values are currently all empty
popup.environmentLayer.seaClassNote: Classes A, B and C are marine environment classes defined by use, not a judgement of a single sample
popup.environmentLayer.seaUpdated: Sampled about quarterly; the dataset is updated every quarter to half a year
popup.environmentLayer.srcSea: Ocean Conservation Administration, Ocean Affairs Council: national marine water quality stations
popup.environmentLayer.rpiDownMouth: No station downstream; extended to the river mouth. Reaches near the mouth may be tidal (not verified with tide data)
popup.environmentLayer.rpiDownEnd: No station downstream; extended to the end of the channel
popup.environmentLayer.rpiReassigned: Registered by the Ministry of Environment as {raw}; matched to {assigned} by location
popup.environmentLayer.methodText: An upstream station represents the reach down to the next station; this is not continuous monitoring or spatial interpolation
popup.environmentLayer.tidalSectionText: In tidal reaches a single sample's RPI is less representative. Tidal influence is only assessed for the Tamsui River and Gaoping River; confirmed tidal reaches are drawn dashed on the map and other basins are not assessed
popup.environmentLayer.coverageText: Rivers across Taiwan that have RPI stations; rivers without stations are not coloured, which does not mean they are clean
popup.environmentLayer.srcRpiSegments: Ministry of Environment river water quality monitoring (RPI) + Water Resources Agency channel areas and basin extents + {attribution}
popup.environmentLayer.pm25Coordinates: Coordinates are those of the air quality automatic station of the same name
popup.environmentLayer.pm25Sampling: Manual sampling gives about one daily average every 3 days; not real time
popup.environmentLayer.pm25Color: The colours share their source with the five PM2.5 levels of micro sensors, changed to a continuous gradient; this is not AQI
popup.environmentLayer.srcPm25: Ministry of Environment manual PM2.5 monitoring (aqx_p_10)
popup.environmentLayer.dioxinStale: The latest sample is out of date (hollow grey dot) and does not reflect current conditions
popup.environmentLayer.dioxinSampling: Regular sampling, about 1–2 times every six months; not real time
popup.environmentLayer.dioxinColor: The sequential colour shows relative levels only and is not compared with standards
popup.environmentLayer.incineratorUpdate: Monthly (Ministry of Environment monthly report, lagging 1–2 months); dioxin is the latest valid test of each furnace
popup.environmentLayer.compareText: The dataset has no emission standards, so this map does not judge exceedance; colours show the relative NOx level
popup.environmentLayer.srcIncinerator: Ministry of Environment incinerator air pollution monitoring (fac_s_04)
popup.environmentLayer.nuscStale: Not updated for over 30 minutes (hollow grey dot); not a real-time value
popup.environmentLayer.nuscHigh: Above normal background; refer to the Nuclear Safety Commission announcements
popup.environmentLayer.nuscBackground: Normal environmental background is about 0.04–0.14 μSv/h (affected by geology, altitude and rainfall)
popup.environmentLayer.nuscUpdated: Every 15 minutes; the map refetches every 15 minutes
popup.environmentLayer.nuscDistinction: The Nuclear Safety Commission national environmental radiation network; separate from the Taipower nuclear plant perimeter monitoring (Disasters / Nuclear safety)
popup.environmentLayer.srcNusc: Nuclear Safety Commission, Radiation Monitoring Center: national real-time environmental radiation monitoring
popup.environmentLayer.liveError: The data service failed to respond. Please try again later.
popup.environmentLayer.effluentStale: Data timed out (not updated for over 3 hours)
popup.environmentLayer.effluentJudge: Exceedance follows the upstream status "over limit"; it is not recalculated from standard values
popup.environmentLayer.effluentUpdated: Hourly; the map refetches hourly; if a county's upstream feed stops updating, it is shown as timed out
popup.environmentLayer.srcEffluent: Ministry of Environment real-time effluent data from online automatic water volume and quality monitoring
popup.environmentLayer.cemsStale: Data timed out (not updated for over 6 hours)
popup.environmentLayer.cemsDelay: The upstream feed lags by about 4–5 hours; the observation time is not now
popup.environmentLayer.cemsJudge: Over-limit follows the upstream status code "value over limit"; operating status uses the first letter of each item's status code (N operating, F suspended, G overhaul…)
popup.environmentLayer.cemsCoords: Coordinates of facilities regulated by the Ministry of Environment; facilities that cannot be matched to the registry are not drawn
popup.environmentLayer.srcCems: Ministry of Environment stationary pollution source CEMS continuous automatic monitoring
popup.environmentLayer.uvStale: Data not updated for over 2 days (hollow grey dot)
popup.environmentLayer.uvText: The CWA publishes each station's maximum UV index for the previous day, not the current UV level
popup.environmentLayer.uvUpdated: Daily; the map refetches every 6 hours
